query: How do review facets differ by sentiment label?

per_column.name: review_aspect_domain
per_column.rationale: Product category domain is an external, interpretable segmentation independent of sentiment; one can compare positive/negative rates across media vs physical vs food.

per_column.name: product_quality_signal
per_column.rationale: Praised/criticized/mixed quality is essentially the sentiment expressed about the product, strongly collinear with label_pos; it largely restates the focus rather than opening an external relationship.

per_column.name: emotional_intensity
per_column.rationale: Intensity is a separate dimension from valence; positive and negative reviews can both be intense, so it supports meaningful cross-tabulation with sentiment. Categories are well-separated ordinal levels.

per_column.name: negative_emotion_type
per_column.rationale: Presence/type of negative emotion is nearly definitional of negative sentiment; heavily collinear with label_pos, so it mostly restates the focus.

per_column.name: positive_emotion_type
per_column.rationale: Presence/type of positive emotion is nearly definitional of positive sentiment; strongly collinear with label_pos and largely restates the focus.

per_column.name: expectation_outcome
per_column.rationale: Whether expectations were met is correlated with but conceptually distinct from valence; well-separated ordinal categories allow interpretable segmentation of how outcomes relate to sentiment.

per_column.name: defect_type
per_column.rationale: Type of defect is an external, interpretable categorical facet; while defects skew negative, the specific defect category (hardware, content, durability) offers meaningful segmentation beyond bare sentiment.

per_column.name: recommendation_stance
per_column.rationale: Recommend vs discourage is essentially a proxy for sentiment polarity, highly collinear with label_pos, so it mostly restates the focus rather than opening a new relationship.

judge.rationale: The set is well-formed with interpretable, well-separated categorical scales suitable for grouping and cross-tabulation against sentiment. However, roughly half the columns (product_quality_signal, negative_emotion_type, positive_emotion_type, recommendation_stance) are near-tautological with the sentiment label and largely restate the focus, limiting genuine discovery. The remaining columns (aspect_domain, emotional_intensity, expectation_outcome, defect_type) do open external, informative relationships—covering product domain, arousal, expectation dynamics, and failure modes—making the set moderately, but not strongly, informative for exploratory analysis.
